subject: Fix "time_t' different  typedef  on 32-bit /64-bit systems (#3787)
reason: The change only corrects printf format specifiers for time_t/long on 32-bit builds (valkey-check-aof messages, INFO lru_clock cast, internal fuzzer generator) and adds a 32-bit Alpine CI job. On the 64-bit platform the fuzzer runs on, time_t is a 64-bit long, so %ld and %jd with an intmax_t cast, and %u with or without the unsigned-int cast of a 24-bit masked value, produce byte-identical output: no reply, tool output, crash, or data behavior differs between the parent and the change, so any expect_difference would be unreachable.
